verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents its own token-authenticated REST API, with create, update and delete endpoints for monitors and copyable curl examples. It also points to Terraform for automating workflows, so it can be driven without the UI. The evidence never shows a CLI, CI pipeline integration, or a documented headless/CI workflow, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: official CLI, documented CI pipeline usage (e.g. GitHub Actions), published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Automate your workflows and integrate Better Stack with your existing tools using our APIs and protocols. ... Terraform
Simply include an `Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN` header in your requests.
Create monitor POST ... Update monitor PATCH ... Remove monitor DELETE
A global API token is a token valid across all your teams, for managing anything within Better Stack.
